text:
raj: FYI - seeing KMS API 502s in eu-west-1 and elevated packet loss to the cloud provider's control plane. Affects key unwraps for model loads on dedicated pools.
nina: Observability - token decrypt failures, KV cache misses ~30% on eu-west-1 GPU hosts. Latency spikes, autoscaler not catching up.
mike: Confirmed, several GPU nodes reporting 'failed to fetch key' during model init -> fallback path triggers but it's slower, causing queueing and degraded throughput.
oliver: Any idea if this is pure network or KMS backend? traceroutes show timeouts to provider KMS frontends and 5xx from their API.
raj: Looks like provider networking + KMS control plane - both degraded. They've posted a brief incident note in status: https://status.cloudvendor.example/incident/9876
sre-bot: alert: high_error_rate on eu-west-1/kube-gpu-pool between 1749901100 - 1749901200.
mike: Immediate mitigation options: 1) traffic-shift model loads to eu-central-1 2) enable local fallback keys from Vault (short-lived) 3) throttle PLG free-tier traffic to preserve paid SLA. Any preference?
nina: We should prioritize noisy tenants and SLA customers. Start partial traffic-shift + enable Vault unwrap for critical routes. Spinning up more GPUs in eu-central will take ~10-12m.
raj: Agreed. Oliver can you run the traffic-shift plan A (region failover for canary routes) and mike start Vault fallback for auth svc? Keep a 10% canary before wide shift.
oliver: Kicking off region shift (canary 10%) now via routing service:
```
# route service CLI
route set --from eu-west-1 --to eu-central-1 --service models-api --percent 10 --tag incident-174990
```
deploy-bot: rollout started: models-api routing change (10% -> eu-central-1).
mike: Enabling KMS fallback for critical tenants (SLA IDs in /infra/incident/174990/list.txt). Commands to enable local unwrap:
```
curl -X POST https://admin-api.internal/ops/kms/fallback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"fallback_key":"vault:aes-024","tenants":["acct-123","acct-789"],"ttl":900}'
```
raj: Make sure Vault key is in HSM-backed cluster and audit logging enabled. Log actions in the incident ticket.
mike: Done. Verified unwraps against vault for two tenants: success. Model loads for those tenants dropped decrypt failures to 0.
nina: Traffic-shift to 10% looks stable for 5m, latency slightly higher (+30ms) but throughput OK. Proceed to 50% if no regressions.
oliver: Pushing to 50% now.
deploy-bot: routing update complete: models-api 50% -> eu-central-1.
ops-oncall: Heads-up on cost: cross-region egress and extra reserved GPU spin-ups will add ~$8K/day if we keep this steady. Recommend gating by paid-tier only.
raj: Good call. Enforce policy to route only paid-tier + internal monitoring. Nina, can you apply traffic policy?
nina: Policy applied: free-tier flagged -> stay in eu-west queue (best-effort). Paid and enterprise routed to eu-central failover.
mike: Note: when fallback keys used, we bypass provider KMS for unwrap but still need provider KMS for key rotation events. That path remains degraded. Plan for longer maintenance: rotate back once provider KMS healthy.
raj: Also reduce concurrency on batch workers in eu-west to free up GPUs for active sessions. Command: `kubectl patch hpa batch-workers -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas":1}}'`
oliver: Done. Batch concurrency down, freed ~18% of GPU slots. Some background jobs queued.
sre-bot: update: error_rate in eu-west-1 reduced from 32% -> 12% after throttles and batch reductions.
raj: Provider just updated status: networking partially restored but KMS control-plane still degraded. https://status.cloudvendor.example/incident/9876#update2
mike: Re-testing KMS endpoints - still getting occasional 502s (3/20 calls). Vault fallback still needed.
nina: Start runbook for customer comms and post-incident checklist. Assigning postmortem to raj + mike + oliver.
ops-oncall: We're keeping paid-tier traffic on failover until provider confirm full recovery. Cost center alert created.
raj: Provider just reported resolution at 1749906600, control plane restored. Begin rollback of fallbacks and routing to eu-west.
oliver: Starting canary rollback (10% -> eu-west).
deploy-bot: routing update: models-api 10% -> eu-west-1.
mike: Rolling back Vault fallback for tenants we temporarily enabled:
```
curl -X POST https://admin-api.internal/ops/kms/fallback/disable \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenants":["acct-123","acct-789"]}'
```
raj: Validate unwraps from provider KMS for a few sample loads then fully shift.
mike: Provider unwraps successful for samples. Metrics look clean.
oliver: Completed full traffic return to eu-west-1.
deploy-bot: routing update complete: models-api 100% -> eu-west-1.
sre-bot: final: error_rate eu-west-1 back to baseline (~1.2%).
nina: Good job. We'll cut a postmortem and include mitigation improvements: - pre-warm fallback keys for SLA tenants - faster regional autoscale playbooks - cost controls for cross-region failover.
raj: Filing incident ticket INC-2026-174990 and assigning action items. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: Creating billing run and notifying finance for emergency spend approval.
mike: Leaving logs and commands used in /infra/incident/174990/ so oncall can reproduce.
raj: Incident closed for now. Postmortem draft ETA EOD tomorrow.
